text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a short maintenance window for a base-image rebuild + RBAC refresh tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need triage plan for any vuln noise, KMS signer rotation confirmation, and audit-log forwarding checks. Who can own what?
Alex: I can own KMS signer rotation. Quick Q — do we rotate the signer key or create a new key version and update cosign refs?
Jordan: Prefer new key version + update references. Safer rollback. Also: will this affect Dedicated pools that pin images?
Maya: Good call. Yes — Dedicated pools will need the new signed images pushed and a rollout policy. Sam, can you check Dedicated rollout constraints?
Sam: On it. I'll validate side-channel (image digests) and preflight the canary pool. ETA 2 hours.
Alex: For cosign: plan is create new key version, cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/2 <image> and then update the signing policy file. We'll also update the keystore ACLs.
Maya: We also need to update RBAC so the build CI service account can sign with new key version. Current binding = roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for ci-build-sa. New binding should be roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier? Are we using custom roles?
Jordan: We created a narrow role last quarter: roles/redwood.kmsSigner. It includes cloudkms.cryptoKeySign on the key. Use that instead of broad roles. I'll attach the policy doc fragment in a sec.
DeployBot: Build pipeline detected a pending image scan for base-image:nightly-2026-03-20 — 3 medium CVEs, 1 low.
Maya: CVEs — can we triage quickly? If they're library backports we can rebuild with patched deps, otherwise we might need a temp mitigation. Alex / Jordan, can you check if fixes exist upstream?
Alex: Looking: two are libssl CVE -> upstream has patch in 1.1.1k. We can rebuild base with patched openssl and run quick vuln scan. If upgrade needs ABI tweaks we'll hold and document.
Sam: For audit logs: ensure image-push events and cosign actions are forwarded to our central Splunk index. Current stackdriver->splunk forwarder needs to include the new key resource and service account subject. I can add a forwarding filter: resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND jsonPayload.container=\"image-builder\"
Maya: Also add a policy that all cosign sign operations create an audit annotation with build_id and commit sha. That helps later for forensics.
Jordan: On RBAC change timing: do the KMS binding update during low-traffic window, but keep old key active for ~24h and don't revoke until we've validated. Add explicit TTL and rollback steps.
Alex: Plan for rollback: if signing fails or misconfigured, we should fall back to signed images with old signature and pause new image promotion. Script: 
```
# quick rollback pseudo
gcloud kms keys versions disable --key mykey --version 2 || true
update-image-promotion --use-signature version=1
```
Sam: Canary plan: push to canary pool (10% of Dedicated), wait 30m for metrics (errors, latency, image pull failures), then 50% then 100%. I'll run the rollout playbook.
Maya: Who's owning vuln triage and sign-off to proceed?
Alex: I'll own KMS + signature ops.
Jordan: I'll own RBAC policy MR and the audit annotation schema.
Sam: I'll run the dedicated canary & observability checks, and handle Splunk filter.
Maya: I'll coordinate comms and incident channel. If anything spikes, escalate to eng-sre. Post the build-id and signature digest here.
DeployBot: Automated preflight scan results: base-image-nightly-2026-03-20 -> scan: PASS (after patched openssl) — 0 critical, 0 high, 1 medium (non-exploitable).
Maya: Sweet. Next steps: Alex rotate/create new key version at 08:30 PT, sign test image and drop digest here. Jordan open RBAC MR and ping @eng-security for review. Sam start canary at 09:00 PT and monitor for first 60m.
Jordan: MR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/482 — includes binding for roles/redwood.kmsSigner and audit annotation policy.
Alex: Test sign completed. signature digest: sha256:abcd1234... pushed to staging. Dropping cosign command used: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/2 gcr.io/redwood/base:nightly-2026-03-20`
Sam: Canary started 09:00 PT. Initial pulls green, no auth errors. Monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/kanary-build-482
Maya: Perfect — keep this thread updated. If anyone sees unexpected errors, call the eng-sre pager. :thumbsup:
Alex: Will post final rotation audit log entry (gcloud logs export) when done.
Jordan: Adding post-mortem checklist to the MR.
Sam: Canary 30m check: pass. Proceeding to 50%.
Maya: Thanks all — recording this as coordinated maintenance in the calendar and compliance notes. I'll file a short blameless note after completion.
DeployBot: Event: maintenance-complete recorded by Maya at 10:25 PT. Audit logs forwarded to splunk-index:images-audit.
